subject: planner: relocate table/index scan build logic to physical op dir (#63585)
summary: Refactor-only change: moved task types (Cop/Root/MPP) and table/index scan + index-merge build helpers from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop`, plus mechanical renames (`GetGEAndLogicalOp`, exported task fields/methods). Checked that moved helpers (`ConvertToPartialIndexScan`, `BuildIndexMergeTableScan`, index-lookup task builder, `FinishIndexPlan`/`GetStoreType`) match the pre-move logic and that call sites still invoke them under the same invariants; no plausible Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics regression found.
